title: Platonic-Engram-HNet v2: Disaggregating Compute and Memory Below 1 MB — Tokenizer-Free int8 Byte Routing, O(1) Flash Engrams, Causal Chrono-CfC and Frame-Locked Decoding in Bit-Exact C/C++20 ESP32-S3 Firmware
description:
A sub-1 MB on-device language stack for an ESP32-S3 e-reader that splits the problem along the memory hierarchy instead of shrinking a transformer: a 95 KB looped int8 byte router in PSRAM (no tokenizer), a 4.2 MB O(1) Engram hash table on SD read one 64-byte slot per word, four continuous-time Chrono-CfC entity slots behind causal spoiler gates, and a frame-locked concept decoder over a 4,096-clause bank. PyTorch QAT, NumPy, C11 and the C++20 firmware kernel agree bit for bit.

Project page: https://robertzhou.dev/work/platonic-engram-hnet/
